title: China's market regulator says it is investigating Trip.com, the country's largest online travel agency, over alleged antitrust conduct, without offering details (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: China's market regulator says it is investigating Trip.com, the country's largest online travel agency, over alleged antitrust conduct, without offering details — China is investigating Trip.com Group Ltd. over alleged antitrust conduct, taking aim at the country's dominant online travel platform weeks …
